note: Names removed. Reply is a draft with [CONFIRM] markers; it becomes an approved example only after the broker edits and sends it.
lead_text:
Hello,
We are a family living in Vouliagmeni, with two adults and two children under 18, and we currently have no health insurance policy.
We would like comprehensive coverage for private hospitals, private doctors, specialists, diagnostic tests and emergency visits, including cases where hospital admission is not required.
Our priority is freedom to choose our doctors and private hospitals, with direct payment wherever possible and no requirement to use public hospitals or rely on EOPYY.
Please send us suitable options with low or zero deductibles, the participating hospital list, and details of reimbursement for doctors outside your network. Please also explain any waiting periods, exclusions and annual coverage limits.
Let me know what information you need to prepare a family quotation.
reply_draft:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. I handle English-language enquiries for Generali Greece. Ashlar Assurance also works with the leading insurers, so I can compare other options for you. We are paid only by commission from the insurer whose policy you choose, and we do not charge you any fee. [CONFIRM your exact regulatory status wording]

Generali Life On is a hospital-focused plan with a EUR 1,500 participation (a cost share, not an excess). It suits a family that wants a strong hospital cover at a sensible price. An optional Doctors & Exams add-on extends it to doctor visits and tests. [CONFIRM plan names, direct-billing hospital list and out-of-network reimbursement before sending]

From your message, the following go beyond what Life On offers, so I want to be upfront about it:
- Free choice of doctors / out-of-network reimbursement
- Enriched outpatient cover (specialists, visits, prescriptions, check-ups)
- Nil or low deductible / no participation

If those matter most to you, an international health plan is the better fit, and I can put the two options side by side with prices, deductibles, waiting periods and exclusions so you can choose. I can compare providers such as VUMI, Bupa, Cigna, Allianz Worldwide Care, IMG, APRIL International, OneHealth, Now Health and Morgan Price.

I will also check the policy wording on: diagnostic tests (doctors & exams add-on).

To prepare a quotation I need:
- Full names and dates of birth of everyone to be insured
- Whether each adult holds a valid Greek AFM
- Country of residence and intended start date
- Any existing medical conditions or past treatment (needed for underwriting)

Kind regards,
